author: 站长转发
text:
So for those that are new, or joining, I think it’s very important that you learn the styles of each analyst, and tailor to the one that best reflects you. 

I have a bit more of an aggressive style, as I like to scale into positions, and buy on red days, generally. If youre going to follow me, you have to understand and go in with the mentality of: “Do I have enough capital to fully follow what abi does, if I take a position, will I be sidelined from other opportunities, do I have room to scale in, if I scale in, will that be my entire portfolio?” 

Every play is different, but I don’t like seeing people with smaller accounts sidelined because of one play, I want you to enjoy and experience all the opportunities we have available here. 

I have a consistent month over month win rate of 78-88%, but some plays truly test your patience, some go the next day, and some don’t at all. ❤️

Find the style that best tailors you, and try to avoid the whole: “picking and choosing alerts from a bunch of analysts” because it really diminishes the win rate. Find ONE.
